newsitem.title: USA: PSE&G sees 600 MW N.J. unit up next week.
newsitem.headline: PSE&G sees 600 MW N.J. unit up next week.

text.p: Public Service Electric & Gas Co (PSE&G) said it expected a 600 megawatt (MW) unit at its Hudson coal-fired generating station in Jersey City, N.J., would resume service next week after being shut last weekend.
"The unit will probably come up early next week," said a company spokesman. "It did go out for a tube leak."
The Hudson 2 unit was shut Saturday Oct 12 to repair the problem.
PSE&G, a subsidiary of Public Service Enterprise Group Inc, is the operator and sole owner of the Hudson facility.
